identity.title: Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!

leadText:
Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island! (Japanese: まんがポケモンユナイト～おいでよエオス島～ Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!) is a Pokémon manga created by Hitoshi Ariga. It is based on and provides backstory to . It can be read within Pokémon UNITE on a special website accessed through the Gallery option in the menu. It is also available for reading on the Pokémon UNITE websites and Play Nintendo. It has been released in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Hindi, Indonesian, Russian, Thai, and Turkish.

The first two chapters were released in Asia on May 13, 2022 and internationally on May 17, 2022. The next two chapters were released internationally on October 13, 2022 and in Japan on November 16, 2022.
